sig: [[["A", "Hi, this message is for Daniel Park in the accounts team. This is Rachel Moore from Brightline Retail."], ["A", "I'm calling about invoice number 4471, which your company sent us on March third."], ["A", "I just wanted to give you a heads-up that our payment is going to be a little late this month."], ["A", "We're switching to a new accounting system, and all of our payments have been on hold since Monday."], ["A", "Our finance director has assured me that everything should be up and running again by next Wednesday."], ["A", "So you can expect the full amount, about twelve thousand dollars, by the end of next week."], ["A", "I know this isn't ideal, and I'm really sorry for the inconvenience."], ["A", "Believe me, we're as frustrated as you are."], ["A", "In the meantime, could you send me a copy of the invoice by e-mail?"], ["A", "Our new system needs a digital version, and I can't seem to find the original."], ["A", "You can reach me at 555-0193 if you have any questions."], ["A", "Thanks so much, Daniel, and talk to you soon."]], {"A": "F-US"}]
